method: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/planning/spec.md, dev.json, gen_1..gen_3 and the checker code in lab/core.py. Re-derived every expected answer independently (python brute force for shortest paths, visiting-order permutations, timetable simulations, subset/knapsack/kit enumeration, tiered pricing; direct arithmetic for the rest). Probed edited checkers with 25 correct and wrong surface forms. Model was not run (held-out).

notes: No original expected answer was wrong: all 42 matched my independent derivation.

prompts_adjusted counts tasks whose numbers were changed because the correct answer also appeared verbatim in the prompt (g4-13, g5-02, g5-09); their expected values/negatives were recomputed, they are not counted under answers_fixed.

Kept as acceptable overlap with dev.json: g4-10/g4-16 (timetable with transfer buffer, like dev-08 but earliest-arrival and three-leg variants) and g5-08 (pair selection with JSON answer, like dev-09 but with a weight limit and a cheapest-valid choice).
Not changed: difficulty split is 7/7/7 in both files, slightly fewer easy tasks than the 40% the spec suggests.
Known residual strictness: number checks read the last number on the ANSWER line, so extra numbers after the answer on that line would fail (the prompts ask for the number only).
